content.text: •viral LRTI in children <2y in fall & winter - inflam → ↑mucus · edema · sm airway obstruct · atelectasis
•contagious - spread by direct contact w nasal secretions · airborne droplets · fomites
•all ages but most severe in young infants - peak 3-6mo · MCC LRTI in 1st yr of life
•Rhinovirus (2nd MCC) · Adenovirus · Influenza virus · Parainfluenza virus · coronavirus · human metapneumovirus
- major cause of illness & hsp in children <2y

•<3mo in age · exposure to cigarette smoke · prematurity (<37wks, esp <29wks) · crowded conditions (day care) · C-section · ↓birth wt · chronic lung dz/airway insuff · congenital heart, lung or immune deficiency
RF for severe dz: <3mo · prematurity · ↓birth wt · chronic airway dz or airway abnorm · CHD · neuro dz · immunodeficiency
RF: <37wks · ↓birth wt · <12wks · chronic pulm dz · sig CHD · immunodeficiency
Exacerbating: 2nd-hand smoke · crowded living · high altitude
⍉RF: formula feeding (breast milk protective) · post-term birth (↑fetal & neonatal mortality after 40wks) - vaginal delivery → milder dz than C-section
(fever · URI sxs) for 1-3d (fever · nasal congestion · rhinorrhea) → LRI →
•then LRTI Sx: poor feeding · progressive cough · wheezing
•early: fussiness · poor feeding · low-grade fever · runny nose · congestion · apnea
PE: tachy · retractions · crying · agitation - wheezing & crackles
•↑RR · fever · fine rales · hypoxia · otitis media
•severe: progressive resp distress · tachypnea · nasal flaring · retractions · irritability · cyanosis
Self-limited - peaks 3-5d then gradual improvement - mild resolves over 1-3wks
•<12wks or exacerbating factors/comorbid → prolonged course & comps: dehydration · aspiration PNA · apnea · resp failure · rarely 2ndry bact infect
•persistently ↑resp effort: tachypnea · nasal flaring · IC/subcostal/suprasternal retractions · accessory musc use · grunting
Blood work only if bact infect suspected
•⍉routinely performed - may be used to r/o other Eti · high risk · underlying conditions or comps
Labs for RSV: rapid nasal swab · PCR · ELISA · immunofluorescent assay - may help in some cases
•clin + age + season + PE - confirm: rapid NP RSV test · ABG · CBC · pulse ox · blood cx · serum chem · UA
•toxic → CXR to r/o bact PNA or CHF
*pulse ox single best predictor of dz in children
•O2 = best tx in young children - hydration · nasal & oral suctioning · cardioresp monitoring · fever mgnt
•⍉1st-line meds: ⍉α/β agonists (⍉albuterol · ⍉Epi) · ⍉abx · ⍉antivirals · ⍉decongestants · ⍉steroids - only in select severe dz/comps
•healthy children recover fully w supportive care
Nonsevere → home: adequate hydration · freq nasal suctioning · humidified air · close monitoring for progression
•bulb suctioning for nasal congestion · monitor for clin decline
•⍉bronchodilators · ⍉glucocorticoids · ⍉leukotriene inhibitors in immunocompetent infants w nonsevere dz
•⍉inhaled glucocorticoids (⍉budesonide · ⍉dexamethasone · ⍉fluticasone) - ⍉prevent recurr wheezing · ⍉montelukast - ⍉effect on course or prev
O2 sat <95-96% · <3mo · RR >70 · nasal flaring · retractions · to atelectasis on CXR

•toxic appearance · poor feeding · lethargy · dehydration · mod-severe resp distress (nasal flaring · IC/subcostal/suprasternal retractions · RR >70 · dyspnea · cyanosis) · apnea · hypoxemia · parents unable to care at home
Severe/inpt: fluid mgnt w close I&O monitoring · freq nasal suctioning · supplemental O2 PRN · ± inhaled bronchodilator
•resp support to keep SpO2 >90-92% - heated humidified HFNC or CPAP before intubation if stable · intubation if hemodynamically unstable
during 1st yr of life for children <29wks · Sxtomatic chronic lung dz of prematurity · congenital Hdz · neuromusc difficulties · immunodeficiency

•nirsevimab: long-acting mAb (passive immunization) - extended ½ life → single IM inj covers RSV season - infants <8mo born during/entering 1st RSV season + certain high-risk 8-19mo entering 2nd season
•clesrovimab: alt mAb for infants <8mo in 1st RSV season
•⍉RSV vax for children (mAbs = passive immunity) - vax available for older adults & preg pts
Parent ed: hand hygiene · clean surfaces · ↓cigarette smoke exposure · avoid sick contacts & crowded areas during RSV season - breastfeeding ↓severe dz
